adapters.exportDuty: Leaves with us: nothing needs to — error events are short-retention diagnostics, scrubbed of PII before send. Export: the alert and monitor configuration (tooling/monitor-register.json is already the source). The Sentry protocol is open, so any Sentry-compatible sink takes the same client with a new DSN.
Nothing leaves: the no-op client records nothing and has no record to export.

_why: L2: callers hold a TelemetryClient; TelemetryBootstrap.init is the one place that chooses, from configuration (an empty GLITCHTIP_DSN selects the no-op client).
The adapter is named for the SDK (sentry_flutter) and its vendor is the sink it posts to, GlitchTip, self-hosted; GLITCHTIP_DSN is a write-only ingest key classified build-config, not a secret.
The server half of the glitchtip vendor (heartbeats, GLITCHTIP_TOKEN) is not behind this port; port-telemetry brings it.
